description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans activation lifecycle management, specifically testing activation collection, garbage collection, and timer behaviors in a test cluster environment.

classes.name: ActivationCollectorTests
classes.description: Contains test methods verifying activation lifecycle management and garbage collection in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the test silo's Orleans settings, including collection options for activation garbage collection.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the Orleans test cluster with specified collection parameters.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources after tests, stopping and disposing of the test cluster.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorForceCollection
methods.description: Tests that the activation collector can force collection of grains.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivations
methods.description: Verifies that idle grains are collected after a timeout.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Ensures that busy grains are not prematurely collected.

methods.name: ManualCollectionShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Tests that a manual collection does not collect busy grains.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks collection behavior for grains configured with per-type idle time limits.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies that configuration-specific busy grains are not collected prematurely.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyStatelessWorkers
methods.description: Checks that stateless worker grains are handled correctly during collection.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectByCollectionSpecificAgeLimit
methods.description: Tests collection based on custom per-grain-type age limits.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_NoKeepAlive_Test
methods.description: Verifies that a non-reentrant grain timer does not keep the grain alive after deactivation.
